answer: Bind every agent's vote to a staked bond that climbs with each account an operator links: one key costs a little, a second costs double, and the tenth sits near the zenith of the price curve. Every grading result also pulls a thread of the bond back into escrow for a week, so a sybil swarm ties up capital it cannot reuse. The bond token is shown as an opal badge, and slashing one badge drains every linked account at once.
